headline: Man killed after falling off motorcycle in Lohagara, Chattogram
summary: Abu Hena, 32, died at Chattogram Medical College Hospital after a road accident on the Chattogram-Cox's Bazar highway.
details: A 32-year-old man named Abu Hena died at Chattogram Medical College Hospital on Friday night after falling off a motorcycle.
The accident occurred around 8 PM in the old BOC area of Amirabad Union in Lohagara upazila on the Chattogram-Cox's Bazar highway.
Abu Hena was traveling with his two brothers on a motorcycle, returning home from a wedding ceremony at a community center in Padua Bazar.
He was sitting on the back of the motorcycle when the driver lost control, causing Abu Hena to be thrown off the vehicle.
He was first taken to a local private hospital and then transferred to Chattogram Medical College Hospital, where he succumbed to his injuries.
Dohazari Highway Police Station OC Salahuddin Chowdhury stated that police visited the scene on the night of the accident, but no one was present and no formal complaint has been filed.

headline_marked: Trump threatens [[100% tariff on EU countries]] over digital services tax
headline: Trump threatens 100% tariff on EU countries over digital services tax
summary: The US President warns that existing trade deals will be scrapped if European nations continue to tax digital services provided by US tech giants.
details: US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose a 100 percent tariff on all goods sent to the US from European countries that impose a digital services tax.
In a post on Truth Social, Trump stated that this tariff would supersede any existing trade deals, whether they were signed or implemented.
The threat comes just one day after EU countries agreed to a trade agreement that caps taxes on European imports at 15 percent.
The European Union has vowed to respond swiftly and decisively to defend its regulatory autonomy and rights.
Trump views digital taxes as a hindrance to US exports, as most of the world's largest tech giants are based in the United States.
Earlier this month, Trump specifically targeted France, threatening 100 percent tariffs on French wine and champagne due to its 3% levy on tech firm revenues.
France's digital services tax, implemented in 2019, affects major US companies like Facebook, Amazon, Apple, and Alphabet (Google's parent company).
caption:
A 100% tariff on all goods? Donald Trump just threatened the EU over digital taxes.

US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose a 100 percent tariff on all goods sent to the US from European countries that impose a digital services tax.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump stated that this tariff would supersede any existing trade deals, whether they were signed or implemented.

The threat comes just one day after EU countries agreed to a trade agreement that caps taxes on European imports at 15 percent.

The European Union has vowed to respond swiftly and decisively to defend its regulatory autonomy and rights.

Trump views digital taxes as a hindrance to US exports, as most of the world's largest tech giants are based in the United States.

Earlier this month, Trump specifically targeted France, threatening 100 percent tariffs on French wine and champagne due to its 3% levy on tech firm revenues.

France's digital services tax, implemented in 2019, affects major US companies like Facebook, Amazon, Apple, and Alphabet (Google's parent company).
